title: PATCH /api/projects/:id — update project fields
description: Update editable project fields (name, description, type, status). Log a status_change timeline event when status changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts partial body: { name?, description?, type?, status? }
Returns 404 if project not found or unauthorized
When status changes, a status_change timeline event is logged
updated_at is refreshed on every update

steps.details: In validators/projects.ts, add updateProjectSchema = z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(255).optional(), description: z.string().max(5000).optional(), type: z.enum([...]).optional(), status: z.enum(['active','on_hold','completed','archived']).optional() }).

1) getOwnedProject(id, userId). 2) Validate body. 3) Detect status change: if body.status && body.status !== project.status, save oldStatus. 4) Update project with new fields + updated_at = NOW(). 5) If status changed, log timeline event type='status_change', payload={from: oldStatus, to: newStatus}. 6) Return 200 with updated project.
PATCH with new name — verify updated. Change status from active to completed — verify timeline event created. Try updating another user's project — expect 404.
